page_title: Flixier: Free Online Video Editor With AI Editing

summary.name: Flixier
summary.one_liner: Flixier is a browser-based video editor with cloud rendering, automatic captions in 130+ languages, and an AI assistant called Eva that can make a first cut or generate a full video.
use_cases: Editing YouTube videos and cutting shorts
Making captioned social videos for Reels, TikTok and Shorts
Creating product demos with screen recording and AI voiceover
Generating a full video from a one-sentence prompt
Collaborating on company training videos with a shared brand kit
summary.what_it_does: Flixier runs entirely in the browser with no installation, offering multi-track video and audio editing, a stock library, and text, music and logo tools. Audio can be cleaned in one click and speech can be captioned automatically. Renders run on Flixier's cloud servers rather than the user's machine, and exports can be sent directly to YouTube, TikTok or Google Drive. Its AI assistant Eva can make a first cut from instructions, or write a script, generate shots, record a voiceover and assemble a complete video from one sentence. Team features include timeline comments, a shared brand kit and export presets.
notable: Cloud rendering so exports run on Flixier's servers instead of the user's laptop
Eva AI assistant can generate a complete video from one sentence or make a first cut
Automatic captions in 130+ languages and edit-by-transcript on paid tiers
Free tier with watermark, 720p and 10 min monthly export
caveats: Free plan is limited to 10 min of export per month, 720p, a 2 GB store and a Flixier watermark
Key features such as 4K, no watermark, Brand Kit and AI video generation are on paid Creator and Business tiers
AI features run on a credit system; the page lists credit allowances per tier
